I made a mistake earlier. The correct exam is:

What is the relationship between the Ising model and QUBO?
A) QUBO is a subset of the Ising model
B) The Ising model is a subset of QUBO
C) QUBO and the Ising model are equivalent
Correct answer: B) The Ising model is a subset of QUBO

What is the purpose of Quantum Annealing?
A) Solving Linear Equations
B) Optimizing Non-Linear Functions
C) Finding Global Minimums
Correct answer: C) Finding Global Minimums

What is the benefit of using Quantum Annealing?
A) Speed
B) Accuracy
C) Scalability
Correct answer: C) Scalability

What is the main concept discussed in Lecture 7?
A) Quantum Computing
B) Classical Computing
C) Quantum Annealing
Correct answer: A) Quantum Computing

What is the definition of QUBO?
A) Quantum Bit
B) Quantum Annealing
C) Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization
Correct answer: C) Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization
